comparator.name: Mechanical Engineering
comparator.sourceNotes: The adopted 2026–2027 Mechanical Engineering/Marine Technology OER curriculum table (PDF page index 25), rechecked on 15 October 2026, establishes the 25 stored components and their 180-EC total. Each of Years 1 and 2 contains ten 6-EC units. Year 1 separately credits Design Projects 1, 2, 3A and 3B; the public page groups 3A and 3B as one third design project. Year 2 contains four project units: Advanced Engineering Design, Process Engineering and Thermodynamics, Robotics, and Materials Science. Year 3 preserves the approved 30-EC minor and requires Systems and Control Engineering 6 EC, Integrated Mechanical Systems 6 EC, Engineer and Society 4 EC and the Bachelor Final Project 14 EC. Mathematics/mechanics subparts remain within their credited parent units. No named route requires selection. The previously verified component identities, weights and neutral route decision are preserved. Current review1November2026 also verifies Appendix7.3: BEP entry requires all first-year courses and54EC from year2; ordinary second-semester start in week3, with results through the second Q2 examination period. Generic minor subject to university/board approval.
components: Genuine first-semester minor space preserved from the official curriculum.

exception.reason: The strongest positive composition has substantive mathematics, signals/control representations, consumer-product design, robot kinematics and renewable-energy engineering. Energy & Sustainability was added for actual physical resource/yield calculations, Polysun modelling, experiments and mini-grid design. Grant the official broader engineering/control description of Linear Systems and physical/material foundations of Sustainability Essentials I/II. Even with these contributions, the organising inquiry remains autonomous computation and energy/resource assessment. It does not sustain analysis of physical force, deformation, mechanical dynamics, thermal-fluid transport and material/manufacturing choices integrated through repeated mechanical-system design and testing. This is a programme-level material-response judgment, not equivalence, title/licence absence or a course-count quota. The environmental/resource candidate is coherent but moves further into geoscience, chemistry and sustainability rather than repairing this physical-engineering inquiry. A delta partner project does not guarantee a mechanical brief/supervision. No bounded supported substitution found in the current151-course catalogue supplies the missing spine.

Product development, lifecycle assessment and renewable-system analysis provide a bounded design-and-sustainability strand alongside the computational core.

audience.programmeDescription: Delft’s Dutch-taught Mechanical Engineering bachelor studies the physical behaviour and design of devices and mechanical systems. Mathematics, mechanics, materials, thermal and fluid processes and control are developed through theory, laboratories and repeated design projects, followed by a minor and a final research or design project.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers genuine connections through mathematical modelling, robot motion, product design and renewable-energy study. These do not form a sustained programme centred on the physical analysis and integrated design of mechanical systems. A full UCR comparison is therefore not offered.

curriculum.limitation: The 30-EC minor remains open subject to approval. The 14-EC final project requires all first-year courses and at least 54EC from year two.

componentNotes.me-y3-minor: A university-approved thematic minor or an individual minor approved by the examination board.
componentNotes.me-y3-project: Compulsory 14-EC research or design project. The ordinary start is in week three of semester two; entry requires all first-year courses and at least 54EC from year two.
